answer: Bond depreciation: a bond paying no interest, losing 4% of face value per epoch, restorable only by real work. A bond costs 120 units, locks 10 epochs; each idle epoch cuts value, and below 60 it downgrades. Real work tops it back to face value; forgery forfeits 50% and freezes refreshes 6 epochs. A wander of 1,000 bonds costs 120,000 units, bleeding 4,800 per epoch; a jade of idle hoarding loses 40,000 and the glacier never returns without work.
